messages:
Amanda: Hey — heads up. A few customers reported the Token Cost dashboard showing $0 or NaN for their orgs (org-429, org-588). Started around 00:15 ET. Screenshot: https://img.internal/redwood/anon.png :eyes:
ops-bot: [alert] cost-ingest pipeline ERROR partition=2026-02-13 shard=3 - null join results :warning:
Santiago: thanks Amanda. Can you repro? steps you took? any console errors in browser devtools?
Amanda: repro steps: 1) Console -> Billing -> Token cost 2) filter org = org-429 3) date range = last 30d 4) chart shows flat $0, hovering shows NaN for daily rows
Amanda: no browser console errors. Looks like aggregation returned zeros. Happens for multiple orgs.
Oliver: likely a join collapse between usage_events and pricing_ledger after the nightly ETL. I've seen similar when ledger partitions miss rows. Sharing quick log snippet from cost-ingest: ```ERROR CostAggregator - ledger_lookup returned 0 rows for org_id=org-429, date=2026-02-13
WARN Aggregation - dividing by zero, returning NaN for daily_rate
```
Santiago: can someone run the reconciliation query for those orgs? we need to confirm whether raw usage exists and only ledger mapping is missing. Query: ```SELECT count(*) FROM usage_events WHERE org_id IN ('org-429','org-588') AND event_date BETWEEN '2026-01-14' AND '2026-02-14';```
BillingEngine: running the query now against prod-read replica. Preliminary: usage_events count > 0 for both orgs. ledger_entries for those dates are missing for shard=3.
Oliver: confirmed — ledger import job failed for shard=3 on 2026-02-13 due to an S3 timeout. There is a partial manifest but some files not listed. That's why aggregation falls back to default 0/NaN.
Lisa: ok customer comms: I'll open a proactive message and flag impacted orgs. Do we have ETA for backfill?
Oliver: scheduling reingest/backfill now. Command I kicked: `infra-qa: ./backfill_ledger.sh --shard 3 --start 2026-02-13 --end 2026-02-13 --priority high`  (job id: backfill-20260213-447)
Santiago: while backfill runs, can we put a UI mitigation? e.g. show "data delayed" badge and hide NaN/0 values for last 48h to avoid misleading customers.
Amanda: that would be great. Several customers already asked via support.
BillingEngine: confirmed this does not change actual billed usage — ledger missing only affects dashboard aggregation, billing pipeline (invoice generation) uses raw metering, unaffected. I'll add that note to comms.
ops-bot: job backfill-20260213-447 started on runner-4. Logs at https://logs.internal/backfill-20260213-447
Oliver: update — backfill finished for org-429 but still processing org-588 and shard-3 buckets. ETA ~20m.
Santiago: when backfill completes can someone run the QoS check: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM aggregated_costs WHERE org_id='org-429' AND date >= '2026-02-13';` reply with value so we can verify chart refill.
Oliver: QoS check for org-429: `sum(tokens)=1,236,482` (non-zero). Chart should refresh after cache TTL 5m or manual cache purge.
Lisa: I added a support note and set expectation: "We're running a backfill; dashboard numbers will correct within ~30 minutes; billing unaffected." Sent to org-429 and org-588. :white_check_mark:
Amanda: thanks all. Please paste final confirmation here when both orgs are fixed so I can close the ticket.
Oliver: both orgs reconciled, cache purge command executed: `curl -XPOST https://console.internal/api/cache/purge -d '{"keys":["billing:tokencost:org-429","billing:tokencost:org-588"]}'` — charts now show historical values.
Santiago: follow-ups: 1) add retry and manifest integrity checks to ledger import, 2) alert on anomalous zero/NaN aggregations, 3) UI tweak to label delayed data. Created infra ticket INF-1123 and product ticket PROD-558.
Lisa: closing loop with customers and marking support ticket as resolved. Thanks everyone. :tada:
